author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಕಲಲರೂಪದಿ ಪಿಂಡ ಗರ್ಭಸ್ಥವಾದೊಡನೆ
ಹಲವಾರು ಭಾವರಸ ಒಂದುಗೂಡುವವು
ಬೆಳೆಯುತಿರೆ ಕಲರವವು ಬೆಳೆದಾಗೆ ತಲ್ಲಣವು
ಪಲಪಲವು ಅನುಭಾವ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: As soon as the embryo settles in the womb as kalala,
many feelings and flavours come together;
while it grows, there is happy chatter; once grown, turmoil:
manifold are life's experiences, O deluded one.
en.note: Kalala is the earliest stage of the embryo in the traditional account of conception.
en.bhavartha: From the moment life takes shape in the womb, many emotions gather in it. Childhood is full of cheerful noise, and adulthood brings its anxieties. Life holds every kind of experience.
